subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.9 QQBot: long markdown reply is split into N independent bubbles (one per chunk), not a single message

question: Should QQBot preserve the current one-message-per-safe-Markdown-chunk behavior, or merge safe chunks into one QQ bubble when the combined payload fits a verified QQ API limit?
rationale: Current main intentionally chunks Markdown for QQ safety, an open PR proposes merging safe chunks, and a member comment says the split behavior is by design; automation cannot choose the permanent user-visible channel policy.

options.title: Keep intentional chunking
options.body: Close or reject the merge-chunks PR and document that QQBot sends multiple complete Markdown messages to avoid truncation and malformed rendering.

options.title: Merge only verified-safe chunks
options.body: Refresh and land a narrow QQBot change that merges chunks only within a live-verified byte limit and keeps overflow chunking with deterministic failure handling.

recommendation.title: Keep intentional chunking
recommendation.body: Close or reject the merge-chunks PR and document that QQBot sends multiple complete Markdown messages to avoid truncation and malformed rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQBot Markdown chunking ownership, assignment on the linked PR, and the latest by-design comment make sliverp the best available owner for this policy choice.
